source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 4 (PDF 75-92), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 4 (Work, Energy and Power) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.
4.1 Work done by a constant force

blocks.prompt:
1 In Physics, the term work involves:
(Physics mein work (kaam) ki istilah kin do cheezon par mushtamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Physics mein work do cheezon par mushtamil hai: force (quwwat) aur displacement (haqeeqi faasla) (4.1).

book_ref.quote: the term work involves two things (i) force, and (ii) displacement

blocks.prompt:
2 When a constant force F displaces an object through d in its own direction, the work done is:
(Jab aik constant force F kisi jism ko apni hi simt mein d faasla le jaye to work kitna hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Work force aur displacement ki magnitudes ka hasil-e-zarb hai, W = Fd (Eq. 4.1).

book_ref.quote: work W is defined as the product of the magnitude of the force F and magnitude of the displacement d

blocks.prompt:
3 A man pushes hard against a wall that does not move. The work done on the wall is:
(Aik aadmi zor se deewar ko dhakelta hai magar deewar nahi hilti. Deewar par kitna work hua?)
blocks.explanation: Agar displacement sifar ho to bari force lagne par bhi work sifar hota hai, jaise deewar dhakelna (4.1).

book_ref.quote: if displacement is zero, no work is done even if a large force is applied

blocks.prompt:
4 If a force F makes an angle θ with the displacement d, the work done is:
(Agar force F displacement d se θ angle banaye to work kitna hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf displacement ke rukh wala component F cos θ work karta hai, is liye W = Fd cos θ (Eq. 4.2).

book_ref.quote: the work done is equal to the product of the component of force along the direction of the displacement

blocks.prompt:
5 Work is written as W = F⃗·d⃗. This shows that work is:
(Work ko W = F⃗·d⃗ likha jata hai. Is se maloom hota hai ke work:)
blocks.explanation: W, F⃗ aur d⃗ ka scalar (dot) product hai, is liye work scalar quantity hai (Eq. 4.3).

book_ref.quote: Equation (4.3) shows that work is a scalar quantity.

blocks.prompt:
6 One joule is equal to:
(Aik joule kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: W = Fd se work ki SI unit N m hai jise joule kehte hain: 1 J = 1 N m (4.1).

book_ref.quote: SI unit of work is N m known as joule (J).

blocks.prompt:
7 Work done by a force is positive when the angle θ between force and displacement is:
(Force aur displacement ke darmiyan angle θ kitna ho to work positive hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agar θ < 90° ho to work positive hota hai (4.1).

book_ref.quote: If θ < 90°, work is done and it is said to be positive work.

blocks.prompt:
8 A force acts on a moving body perpendicular to its displacement. The work done by this force is:
(Chalte hue jism par force us ke displacement par amoodi (perpendicular) amal karti hai. Is force ka work kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: θ = 90° par cos θ = 0, is liye work sifar hai (4.1).

book_ref.quote: If θ = 90°, no work is done.

blocks.prompt:
9 The work done by a force on a body is negative when the angle between force and displacement is:
(Force aur displacement ke darmiyan angle kitna ho to work manfi (negative) hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: θ > 90° par cos θ manfi hota hai aur work negative hota hai (4.1).

book_ref.quote: If θ > 90°, the work done is said to be negative.

blocks.prompt:
10 A constant force of 25 N moves a box 8 m in the direction of the force. The work done is:
(25 N ki constant force aik dabbe ko force ki simt mein 8 m le jati hai. Work kitna hua?)

book_ref.quote: The force displaces the object through a displacement d in the direction of force.

blocks.prompt:
11 A rope pulls a trolley with a force of 40 N at 60° to the displacement. The work done in moving it 5 m is:
(Rassi aik trolley ko displacement se 60° par 40 N se kheenchti hai. 5 m le jane mein work kitna hua?)

book_ref.quote: If the force F makes an angle θ with the displacement d

blocks.prompt:
12 A force of 50 N acts at 30° to the displacement and moves a body 12 m. The work done is about:
(50 N ki force displacement se 30° par amal karke jism ko 12 m le jati hai. Work taqreeban kitna hua?)

book_ref.quote: where the rope pulls at an angle θ to the displacement d

blocks.prompt:
13 A force of 8 N acts on a body while it moves 5 m, and the work done by the force is −40 J. The angle between the force and the displacement is:
(Jism 5 m chalta hai aur us par 8 N ki force ka work −40 J hai. Force aur displacement ke darmiyan angle kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: cos θ = −40/40 = −1, is liye θ = 180°; θ > 90° hai is liye work manfi hai (4.1).

book_ref.quote: From the definition of work, we find that:

blocks.prompt:
14 A frictional force of 15 N acts opposite to the motion of a block while it slides 4 m. The work done by friction is:
(Aik block 4 m phisalta hai aur 15 N ki friction (ragar) harkat ke ulat amal karti hai. Friction ka work kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: If θ > 90°, the work done is said to be negative.

blocks.prompt:
15 For a constant force, the work done is represented on a force-displacement graph by:
(Constant force ke liye force-displacement graph par work kis cheez se zahir hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Force-displacement graph ke neeche ka area Fd ke barabar hai, yani work (Fig. 4.4).

book_ref.quote: the area under a force-displacement curve can be taken as to represent the work done by the constant force

blocks.prompt:
16 A constant force of 12 N acts on a body in the direction of motion from d = 0 to d = 3 m. The area under its force-displacement graph is:
(12 N ki constant force harkat ki simt mein d = 0 se d = 3 m tak amal karti hai. Force-displacement graph ke neeche ka area kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Graph ufqi (horizontal) line hai; rectangle ka area = 12 × 3 = 36 J, yahi work hai (4.1).

book_ref.quote: As the force does not vary, in this case, the graph will be a horizontal straight line.

blocks.prompt:
17 If the force is not along the displacement, the graph used to find work is plotted between:
(Agar force displacement ke rukh mein na ho to work maloom karne ke liye graph kin ke darmiyan banaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab F, d ke rukh mein na ho to graph F cos θ aur d ke darmiyan banta hai (4.1).

book_ref.quote: In case the force F is not in the direction of displacement, the graph is plotted between F cos θ and d.

blocks.text: 4.2 Work done by a variable force

blocks.prompt:
18 As a rocket moves away from the Earth, the force of gravity on it varies:
(Jab rocket Zameen se door jata hai to us par gravity ki force kaise badalti hai?)

options.text: Zameen ke markaz se faasle ke inverse square ke mutabiq

blocks.explanation: Gravity Zameen ke markaz se faasle ke murabba (square) ke ulat badalti hai, is liye yeh variable force hai (4.2).

book_ref.quote: as a rocket moves away from the Earth, work is done against the force of gravity

blocks.prompt:
19 Which is an example of a variable force given in the chapter?
(Chapter mein variable force ki kaun si misaal di gayi hai?)

options.text: Mez par rakhi kitab ka weight
Har jagah aik jaisi rehne wali force

blocks.explanation: Spring ki force khinchao (stretch) ke saath barhti hai, is liye yeh variable hai (4.2).

book_ref.quote: the force exerted by a spring increases with the amount of stretch

blocks.prompt:
20 To find the work done by a variable force, the path is divided into short intervals because during each small interval the force is:
(Variable force ka work nikalne ke liye raasta chhote hisson mein kyun taqseem kiya jata hai? Kyunke har chhote hisse mein force:)
blocks.explanation: Har chhote hisse mein force taqreeban constant maani jati hai, is liye ΔW = F cos θ Δd (4.2).

book_ref.quote: During each small interval, the force is supposed to be approximately constant.

blocks.prompt:
21 The total work done by a variable force is found by:
(Variable force ka kul work kaise maloom kiya jata hai?)

options.text: tamam chhote hisson ka work jama karke
sab se bari force ko kul displacement se zarb de kar
sirf pehli aur aakhri force ki average le kar
force ko displacement se taqseem karke

blocks.explanation: W_total = ΔW₁ + ΔW₂ + … + ΔWₙ = Σ Fᵢ cos θᵢ Δdᵢ (Eq. 4.4).

book_ref.quote: The total work done in moving the object can be calculated by adding all these terms.

blocks.prompt:
22 In finding the work of a variable force as a sum of rectangles, the result becomes more accurate when:
(Variable force ka work rectangles ke jama se nikalte hue nateeja kab zyada durust hota hai?)

options.text: Δd ko bohat chhota kiya jaye

blocks.explanation: Faasle ko bohat se hisson mein baant kar har Δd ko bohat chhota karne se nateeja zyada durust hota hai; Δd → 0 par bilkul durust (Eq. 4.5).

book_ref.quote: If we sub-divide the distance into a large number of intervals so that each Δd becomes very small

blocks.prompt:
23 The work done by a variable force between two points P and Q equals:
(Do points P aur Q ke darmiyan variable force ka work kis ke barabar hai?)

options.text: F cos θ banam d curve ki slope
P aur Q par forces ka hasil-e-zarb
P aur Q ke darmiyan F cos θ banam d curve ke neeche ka area
P se Q tak curve ki lambai

blocks.explanation: Variable force ka work P aur Q ke darmiyan F cos θ banam d curve ke neeche ke area ke barabar hai (Fig. 4.7).

book_ref.quote: the work done by a variable force in moving a particle between two points is equal to the area under the F cos θ verses d curve

blocks.prompt:
24 A force stays at 8 N from d = 0 to d = 3 m and then falls uniformly to zero at d = 7 m. The work done from d = 0 to d = 7 m is:
(Aik force d = 0 se d = 3 m tak 8 N rehti hai aur phir yaksaan tor par d = 7 m par sifar ho jati hai. d = 0 se 7 m tak work kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rectangle: 8 × 3 = 24 J; triangle: ½ × 4 × 8 = 16 J; kul = 40 J (4.2).

book_ref.quote: The work done by the force is equal to the total area under the curve from d = 0 to d = 6 m.

blocks.prompt:
25 A force increases uniformly from 0 to 10 N while a body moves from d = 0 to d = 4 m along the force. The work done is:
(Jism d = 0 se 4 m tak force ke rukh mein chalta hai aur force yaksaan tor par 0 se 10 N tak barhti hai. Work kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Line ke neeche triangle ka area: ½ × 4 × 10 = 20 J (4.2).

book_ref.quote: Thus, the work done given by Eq. 4.4 equals the sum of the areas of all the rectangles.

blocks.prompt:
26 The space around the Earth in which its gravitational force acts on a body is called:
(Zameen ke ird gird woh jagah jahan us ki gravitational force jism par amal karti hai, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is jagah ko gravitational field (kashish-e-saql ka maidan) kehte hain (4.3).

book_ref.quote: The space around the Earth in which its gravitational force acts on a body is called the gravitational field.

blocks.prompt:
27 When a ball falls downward, the work done on it by the gravitational force is:
(Jab gaind neeche girti hai to gravitational force us par kaisa work karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Displacement gravitational force ki simt mein hai, is liye work positive hai (4.3).

book_ref.quote: If displacement is in the direction of gravitational force, the work is positive.

blocks.prompt:
28 When a body is lifted upward, the work done on it by the gravitational force is:
(Jab jism ko oopar uthaya jaye to gravitational force us par kaisa work karti hai?)

options.text: us ki kinetic energy ke barabar

blocks.explanation: Displacement gravitational force ke khilaf hai, is liye gravity ka work manfi hai (4.3).

book_ref.quote: If the displacement is against the gravitational force, the work is said to be negative.

blocks.prompt:
29 When a body is moved along a horizontal path in the gravitational field, the work done by gravity is zero because:
(Gravitational field mein jism ko ufqi (horizontal) raaste par le jane mein gravity ka work sifar kyun hai?)

options.text: weight mg raaste ke mutawazi hai
ufqi raaste par jism ka mass nahi hota
weight mg raaste par amoodi hai

blocks.explanation: AD jaise ufqi raaste par mg displacement par amoodi hai, is liye work sifar hai (4.3).

book_ref.quote: The work done along AD is zero, because the weight mg is perpendicular to this path

blocks.prompt:
30 A 2 kg body is moved from the ground to a point 3 m higher, once straight up and once along a long curved path. The work done by gravity along the curved path is:
(2 kg ka jism zameen se 3 m ooncha le jaya jata hai, aik dafa seedha oopar aur aik dafa lambe ghumawdaar raaste se. Ghumawdaar raaste par gravity ka work kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gravity ka work raaste par munhasir nahi: W = −mgh = −2 × 9.8 × 3 = −58.8 J dono raaston par (4.3).

book_ref.quote: the work done by the gravitational force does not depend on the choice of the path

blocks.prompt:
31 To find the work done by gravity along a curved path, the path is imagined as a series of:
(Ghumawdaar raaste par gravity ka work nikalne ke liye raaste ko kis cheez ka silsila samjha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ghumawdaar raaste ko ufqi aur amoodi (vertical) qadmon mein tor kar dekha jata hai; work sirf amoodi qadmon par hota hai (Fig. 4.10).

book_ref.quote: Imagine the curved path to be broken down into a series of horizontal and vertical steps

blocks.prompt:
32 Which statement about the work done by the gravitational force is correct?
(Gravitational force ke work ke baare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Lambe raaste par zyada hota hai
Har raaste par sifar hota hai
Yeh raaste par munhasir nahi hota
Yeh jism ki speed par munhasir hai

blocks.explanation: Gravitational force ka work raaste par munhasir nahi hota (4.3).

book_ref.quote: Work done by gravitational force is independent of the path followed.

blocks.prompt:
33 A body is carried from A up to B and brought back to A. The total work done by gravity on it is:
(Jism ko A se B tak oopar le ja kar wapas A par laya jata hai. Gravity ka kul work kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oopar jate hue −mgh aur neeche aate hue +mgh; band raaste par gravity ka work sifar hai (4.3).

book_ref.quote: Can you prove that the work done, along a closed path, such as ACBA or ADBA (Fig. 4.9), by the gravitational force is zero?

blocks.prompt:
34 A force is called conservative if the work done by it:
(Force ko conservative kab kaha jata hai? Jab us ka work:)

options.text: band raaste mein kabhi sifar na ho
raaste par munhasir na ho, ya band raaste mein sifar ho

blocks.explanation: Force conservative hai agar do points ke darmiyan us ka work raaste par munhasir na ho, ya band raaste mein sifar ho (4.3).

book_ref.quote: If the work done by a force in moving an object between two points is independent of the path followed

blocks.prompt:
35 Which of the following is a conservative force?
(In mein se kaun si force conservative hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gravitational, electrostatic aur elastic spring forces conservative hain (4.3); friction, hawa ki mazahmat aur rocket ki propulsion non-conservative hain.

book_ref.quote: other examples of conservative force are electrostatic force and elastic spring force

blocks.prompt:
36 A force whose work between two points depends on the path of motion is called:
(Woh force jis ka do points ke darmiyan work raaste par munhasir ho, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agar force ka work raaste par munhasir ho to woh non-conservative (ghair-mahfooz) force hai (4.3).

book_ref.quote: A force is non-conservative if the work done by it in moving an object between two points or in a closed path depends on the path of motion.

blocks.prompt:
37 A block is pushed from P to Q against a kinetic friction of 5 N, once along a 6 m path and once along a 10 m path. The work done by friction along the two paths is:
(Aik block ko 5 N ki kinetic friction ke khilaf P se Q tak aik dafa 6 m aur aik dafa 10 m ke raaste se le jaya jata hai. Dono raaston par friction ka work kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Friction ka manfi work = friction × raaste ki lambai: −30 J aur −50 J; work raaste par munhasir hai (4.3).

book_ref.quote: does negative work equal in magnitude to the frictional force multiplied by the length of the path

blocks.prompt:
38 A box is dragged around a closed path of length 8 m against a kinetic friction of 4 N. The total work done by friction is:
(Aik dabba 4 N ki kinetic friction ke khilaf 8 m lambe band raaste par ghaseeta jata hai. Friction ka kul work kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Friction poore raaste par manfi work karti hai: −4 × 8 = −32 J; non-conservative force ka band raaste mein work sifar nahi hota (4.3).

book_ref.quote: Moreover, the total work done by a non-conservative force in a closed path is not zero.

blocks.prompt:
39 Which of the following is listed in the chapter as a non-conservative force?
(Chapter ke mutabiq in mein se kaun si non-conservative force hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hawa ki mazahmat, dhaage ka tension, normal force aur rocket propulsion non-conservative hain; baqi teeno conservative hain (4.3).

book_ref.quote: Other example of non-conservative force are air resistance, tension in a string, normal force and propulsion force of a rocket.

blocks.prompt:
40 Power is defined as:
(Power (taaqat) ki definition kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Power woh sharah (rate) hai jis se work kiya ja raha ho (4.4).

book_ref.quote: Power is the measure of the rate at which work is being done.

blocks.prompt:
41 If work ΔW is done in time Δt, the average power is:
(Agar Δt waqt mein ΔW work ho to average power kya hogi?)
blocks.explanation: P_av = ΔW/Δt (Eq. 4.6).

book_ref.quote: then the average power P_av during the interval Δt is defined as:

blocks.prompt:
42 The instantaneous power is the limit of ΔW/Δt as:
(Instantaneous (lamhaati) power ΔW/Δt ki limit hai jab:)

options.text: sirf ΔW sifar ki taraf jaye

blocks.explanation: P = lim (Δt → 0) ΔW/Δt (Eq. 4.7).

book_ref.quote: If work is expressed as a function of time, the instantaneous power P at any instant is defined as:

blocks.prompt:
43 Power can also be written in terms of force F⃗ and velocity v⃗ as:
(Power ko force F⃗ aur velocity v⃗ ki shakal mein kaise likha ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: ΔW = F⃗·Δd⃗ aur Δd⃗/Δt = v⃗, is liye P = F⃗·v⃗ (Eq. 4.8).

book_ref.quote: where ΔW is the work done in short interval of time Δt.

blocks.prompt:
44 One watt is equal to:
(Aik watt kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Watt aik second mein aik joule work hai, 1 W = 1 J s⁻¹ (4.4).

book_ref.quote: The SI unit of power is watt, defined as one joule of work done in one second.

blocks.prompt:
45 In base units, the watt is:
(Base units mein watt kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 1 W = 1 J s⁻¹ = 1 kg m² s⁻³, jaise Example 4.2 mein (4.4).

book_ref.quote: P = 7.7 × 10² kg m² s⁻³ = 7.7 × 10² W

blocks.prompt:
46 The kilowatt-hour is a unit of:
(Kilowatt-hour kis cheez ki unit hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kilowatt-hour bijli ki energy (tawanai) ki commercial unit hai (4.4).

book_ref.quote: However, a commercial unit of electrical energy is kilowatt-hour.

blocks.prompt:
47 One kilowatt-hour is equal to:
(Aik kilowatt-hour kitne joule ke barabar hai?)

book_ref.quote: One kilowatt- hour is the work done in one hour by an agency whose power is one kilowatt.

blocks.prompt:
48 A motor does 1800 J of work in one minute. Its average power is:
(Aik motor aik minute mein 1800 J work karti hai. Us ki average power kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: The rate, at which work is done, is often of interest in practical applications.

blocks.prompt:
49 A truck engine pushes the truck with a force of 500 N along its velocity of 20 m s⁻¹. The power delivered is:
(Truck ka engine 20 m s⁻¹ velocity ke rukh mein 500 N force lagata hai. Engine ki power kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: In the definition of work, it is not clear, whether the same amount of work is done in one second or in one hour.

blocks.prompt:
50 A 2 kW heater runs for 3 hours. The energy it uses is:
(2 kW ka heater 3 ghante chalta hai. Woh kitni energy istemal karta hai?)

book_ref.quote: Sometimes, for example, in the electrical measurements, the unit of work is expressed as watt second.

blocks.prompt:
51 A 60 kg girl runs up stairs of vertical height 6.0 m in 5.0 s. Her power output is about:
(60 kg ki larki 6.0 m oonchi seerhiyan 5.0 s mein charhti hai. Us ki power taqreeban kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: A 70 kg man runs up a long flight of stairs in 4.0 s.

blocks.prompt:
52 According to the table of approximate powers, which device has the largest power?
(Approximate powers wale table ke mutabiq kis cheez ki power sab se zyada hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jumbo jet ki power taqreeban 1.3 × 10⁸ W hai, car (1.1 × 10⁵ W) aur heater (2 × 10³ W) se kahin zyada (4.4).

book_ref.quote: For Your Information: Approximate Powers

blocks.prompt:
53 The approximate power of a pocket calculator given in the chapter is:
(Chapter mein pocket calculator ki taqreebi power kitni di gayi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table mein pocket calculator ki power 7.5 × 10⁻⁴ W hai; 1.5 W torch aur 120 W rangeen TV ki hai (4.4).

book_ref.quote: For Your Information: Approximate Powers

blocks.prompt:
54 About how much energy does a car use from petrol in its life time, according to the chapter?
(Chapter ke mutabiq aik car apni zindagi mein petrol se taqreeban kitni energy istemal karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Car banane mein taqreeban 9 × 10⁹ J lagti hai aur car zindagi bhar petrol se taqreeban 1 × 10¹² J istemal karti hai (4.4).

book_ref.quote: It takes about 9 × 10⁹ J of energy to make a car

blocks.prompt:
55 The energy of a body is its:
(Kisi jism ki energy (tawanai) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jism ki energy us ki kaam (work) karne ki salahiyat hai (4.5).

book_ref.quote: Energy of a body is its capacity to do work.

blocks.prompt:
56 The energy possessed by a body due to its motion is called:
(Jism mein us ki harkat ki wajah se mojood energy kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Harkat ki wajah se energy kinetic energy (harkati tawanai) hai (4.5).

book_ref.quote: Kinetic energy is the energy possessed by a body due to its motion

blocks.prompt:
57 A book placed on a high shelf has energy due to its changed position. This energy is:
(Oonchi shelf par rakhi kitab mein us ki badli hui position ki wajah se energy hai. Yeh energy kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Badli hui position ki wajah se energy potential energy (makhfi tawanai) hai (4.5).

book_ref.quote: potential energy is the energy possessed by a body due to its changed position

blocks.prompt:
58 Kinetic energy and potential energy are both kinds of:
(Kinetic energy aur potential energy dono kis qisam ki energy hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kinetic aur potential energy dono mechanical energy (mekaniki tawanai) ki qismein hain (4.5).

book_ref.quote: The kinetic energy and the potential energy both are the kinds of mechanical energy.

blocks.prompt:
59 In deriving the formula for kinetic energy, the kinetic energy of a car whose engine is switched off is taken equal to:
(Kinetic energy ka formula nikalte hue, band engine wali car ki kinetic energy kis ke barabar li jati hai?)

options.text: engine band hone se pehle engine ka work
rukne se pehle friction ke khilaf kiya gaya work fd

blocks.explanation: Rukne se pehle car friction ke khilaf fd work karti hai; harkat ki wajah se yeh work us ki kinetic energy hai (4.5).

book_ref.quote: The ability of a body to do work due to its motion is its kinetic energy.

blocks.prompt:
60 As the car slows down and stops, its acceleration is negative because:
(Jab car ahista ho kar rukti hai to us ka acceleration manfi kyun hota hai?)

options.text: car ka mass manfi ho jata hai
yeh harkat ke ulat friction se paida hota hai
us ki velocity hamesha sifar hai

blocks.explanation: Acceleration friction se paida hota hai jo harkat ke ulat hai, is liye a = −f/m (4.5).

book_ref.quote: its acceleration a is negative because it is produced by force of friction f

blocks.prompt:
61 The SI unit of kinetic energy is:
(Kinetic energy ki SI unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kinetic energy jism ke mumkin work ke barabar hai, is liye is ki unit work wali, yani joule hai (4.5).

book_ref.quote: Since, kinetic energy is equal to work which the body is capable of doing

blocks.prompt:
62 A 4 kg trolley moves at 5 m s⁻¹. Its kinetic energy is:
(4 kg ki trolley 5 m s⁻¹ se chal rahi hai. Us ki kinetic energy kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: Let us derive a formula for the kinetic energy of a moving body.

blocks.prompt:
63 If the speed of a car is tripled, its kinetic energy becomes:
(Agar car ki speed teen guna ho jaye to us ki kinetic energy kitni ho jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: K.E. ∝ v², is liye v teen guna karne se K.E. 9 guna (Eq. 4.9).

book_ref.quote: Consider a car running with a constant speed on a road.

blocks.prompt:
64 A body's mass is doubled and its speed is halved. Its kinetic energy becomes:

blocks.prompt:

blocks.explanation: (Δr)² << r₁², is liye chhor diya jata hai: r² = r₁² + r₁Δr = r₁r₂ (4.5).

blocks.prompt:
